verdict.rationale: Apify says it supports Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and its own Crawlee browser automation library, and lets developers build custom Actors with its SDK toolkits. That implies developers can script browser interactions before extracting content. However, the evidence never shows clicking, filling inputs or scrolling specifically, so this rests on a single marketing-level mention plus generic Actor-development docs. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of click, input-fill and scroll interactions, such as Crawlee or Puppeteer page-action code; documentation of how pre-extraction interaction scripts are configured; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
